result.note: The deal timeline is speculative, so the questions test the Section 301 mechanism, the US pharma tariff schedule and India's pharma export exposure, plus the ASEAN meeting venue.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements in the context of US-India trade developments in July 2026:
items: Section 301 investigations by the United States cover unfair trade practices and can trigger tariffs.
The United States buys nearly 38% of India's pharmaceutical exports.
President Trump said generic drugs would face 100% tariffs from 1 August 2026.
questions.ask: How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: The third statement is wrong. Generic drugs stay tariff-free for two years from 1 August, then face 100% tariffs for a year and 200% after that, a schedule meant to push manufacturers to reshore. The US buys USD 9.7 billion of India's USD 25.8 billion in pharmaceutical exports.
questions.source: The United States buys USD 9.7 billion of Indian pharmaceutical exports, nearly 38% of India’s USD 25.8 billion in pharmaceutical exports.

questions.prompt: In July 2026, in which city was the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Foreign Ministers' meeting held?
questions.explain: A senior US official spoke on the sidelines of the ASEAN Foreign Ministers' meeting in Manila. The official said the US-India trade deal was effectively complete and could be signed within three to four months.
questions.source: Speaking anonymously on the sidelines of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Foreign Ministers' meeting in Manila, the official said "The deal... is there. We literally have the paper."
